card.name: First names of athletes and coaches
card.fires_on: The first name (or first part of a name) of a sports figure, such as a baseball pitcher, manager, goalkeeper or coach, right before the surname is given.

modes.label: Baseball player first names
modes.description: First name of a pitcher, manager or player in baseball history text, just before the surname.
